purpose: Explicit SD action capability experiment; never a production quality gate.
negative: low quality, blurry, malformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, text, watermark

cases.prompt: anime illustration, side view of an adult woman with pink hair seated at a desk, writing on a sheet of paper with a pen, her right hand gripping the pen, pen tip touching the paper, her left hand resting on the paper, her head bent down toward her writing, both hands and the paper visible, daylight
cases.failureExample: Holding a pen near paper without visible tip contact is partial, not a completed writing action.

cases.prompt: anime illustration, side view of an adult woman with pink hair drinking from a ceramic cup, one hand gripping the cup, the cup raised and tilted, the rim touching her lips, head and entire cup visible, daylight
cases.failureExample: A cup held at chest height is not drinking.

cases.prompt: anime illustration, side view of an adult woman with pink hair pouring water from a pitcher into a glass on a table, her right hand holding and tilting the pitcher, a visible stream of water flowing from the spout into the glass, her left hand steadying the glass, her head bent down watching the stream, both hands and both vessels visible, daylight
criteria: stream connects spout to receiving glass
cases.failureExample: Two vessels or water drawn away from the receiving glass are insufficient.

cases.prompt: anime illustration, side view of an adult woman with pink hair seated at a table cutting a sheet of paper with scissors, her right hand holding the scissors by the finger loops, her left hand holding the paper, the paper edge between the open blades, her head bent down watching the cut, both hands and the scissors visible, daylight
criteria: recognizable scissors with finger loops and blades
cases.failureExample: A knife or pen is a wrong tool even if a hand touches paper.

cases.prompt: anime illustration, side view of an adult woman with pink hair seated at a table cutting the sealing tape on a closed cardboard box with scissors, her right hand holding the scissors by the finger loops, the blades contacting the tape on top of the box, her left hand steadying the box, her head bent down watching the cut, both hands and the scissors visible, daylight
criteria: box remains closed at this action phase
cases.failureExample: Holding an already open box or writing on it is not cutting the sealing tape.

cases.prompt: anime illustration, side view of an adult woman with pink hair standing beside a shelf, reaching up with her right arm to grasp a cup on a shelf above her head, her right hand touching the cup handle, her head tilted up looking at the cup, the raised arm and shelf visible, daylight
cases.failureExample: A cup beside the face, a lowered arm or a shelf below the head does not satisfy upward reaching.
